def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Detect recurring row patterns of color 8; when two rows share the same
    # pattern but one has an extra rightward 8 extension, mark that extension
    # location in the shorter row with color 1.
    patterns={}
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        cols=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8]
        if cols:
            # A row signature records all occupied columns up to the rightmost
            # 8, but omits the final contiguous run length.
            end=max(cols)
            sig=tuple(row[:end+1])
            patterns.setdefault(sig,[]).append((r,end))
    # Demonstration has a common 8-pattern prefix, with a longer right tail.
    # For each pair sharing the same non-tail structure, color missing tail.
    rows=[(r,[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8]) for r,row in enumerate(grid) if 8 in row]
    if rows:
        # Compare rows with identical left-side occupancy signatures, locate
        # the furthest right extent and highlight suffixes of shorter rows.
        max_end=max(max(cs) for _,cs in rows)
        for r,cs in rows:
            end=max(cs)
            if end<max_end and all(grid[r][c]==0 for c in range(end+1,max_end+1)):
                for c in range(end+1,max_end+1):
                    g[r][c]=1
    return g
PY
